title: Nick Cannon Shared With Howard Stern That He's Open To Have Lucky 13 Kid With 12-Time Grammy Winner Taylor Swift [Watch]
htmlContent:
Nick Cannon is an American actor, comedian, and television host who is known for his outspoken nature and his unique sense of humor. Recently, he has been in the news for his growing family. In June 2021, Cannon became the father of his seventh child, Zen. Since then, he has added five more children to his family, bringing the total number to 12. Cannon has four children with his ex-wife Mariah Carey and eight children with different partners.

In a recent interview with Howard Stern, Cannon made a controversial comment when he said that he wants Taylor Swift to be the mother of his 13th child.

“I’m all in,” he said, after host Howard Stern asked him the random question . “What I do love about Taylor Swift is that she has been so vulnerable and open with all of her music.”

“I think she would relate to me very well,” Nick continued. “We probably will understand each other.”

This statement has garnered a lot of attention and criticism from fans and the media.

While some people found his comment amusing, others were outraged and called him out for his inappropriate behavior. Cannon has yet to clarify whether his comment was meant as a joke or not. However, it's clear that his statement has sparked a conversation about his personal life and his views on fatherhood.
